SL1B SITE INFO: This site is the furthest site down the Tanana (~1.5-2 hours from Fairbanks to site), and relatively close to SL1A. The river bank is not flagged well but there is a nice sandbar at the nearest point to the site. On top of the bank you will find boardwalks. Boardwalks are in really bad shape and need to be replaced! Currently, there are not trees but there are a couple young birch trees in the site, the biggest being 2.1 cm in DBH. Plot stakes are fiber glass and have no tags, and will need to be retagged/replaced with metal stakes.
